units.rawText: Oh... Professor. Hehehe, you've come a bit earlier than I expected... Now that you're here, I assume you've pieced your fragmented memories back together.

units.rawText: Really, Eosphorus asked you that... It seems Eosphorus now is no longer the one I once knew.

units.rawText: I know you have many questions, Professor, and I'm more than willing to answer them if I could; however, with the way I am now, that is something I cannot do.

units.rawText: Assaulting the Oasis, forcing other sectors to lift the Sandbox Barrier, Demiurge, ENIAC, Helena, Odile, and Odette... It's hard to imagine how everything carries a mark of his influence. He had bared his fangs against humanity from the very beginning.

units.rawText: To further his agenda, he used me, and even used the Oasis's Sandbox Barrier to avoid all Sanctifier detection...

units.rawText: ...I see the depths of his despair and the source of his rage. And that understanding makes it even harder for me to accept a future where he destroys Magrasea with his two hands.

units.rawText: Professor... If it were possible, I never wanted you or the Oasis to be drawn into this conflict. But now, we've both been pulled into this storm without a choice.

units.rawText: Will you stand with me and lend your strength to stop Eosphorus together?

units.rawText: Took the words right out of my mouth. In the battle ahead, we'll need you, the one most familiar with the Sanctifiers. Are you willing to stand with us and help put an end to his schemes?
